messages:
maria: Heads up — after rolling CUDA driver 545.12 to the h100-canary pool we started seeing kernel launches fail for FlashAttention / TensorRT plugins. Pods hit `cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice`. Pausing further driver canaries. attaching logs/snippet.

maria: ```
E trt: cuModuleLoadDataEx failed: 218
RuntimeError: cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice: no kernel image is available for execution on the device
nvrtc: PTX arch mismatch: compiled for sm_80 but device sm_90
```

alex: Seen that pattern before. Usually NVRTC emitted PTX that doesn't match the device arch flags. Did we forget to rebuild flashattn/tensorrt-plugins after the driver bump?

jon: I can reproduce on h100-canary-02. TRT builder logs show NVRTC warning about ptx version mismatch. Quick local test: rebuilding flashattn with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=90 fixes the kernel availability.

infra-bot: deploy:cuda-driver/545.12 rolled to h100-canary (user=maria) — 2026-02-14 14:12:03 UTC

sre_ego: Impact signal: ~12% of inference requests in us-west2 fell back to CPU graph. Latency up ~4x on affected routes. Estimated marginal cost +$8k/day if fallback stays. Putting on-call.

ml-ops: Short mitigation: cordon + drain affected canary nodes and route traffic to dedicated-A100 pool. Also block autoscaler from re-provisioning new h100 nodes with the faulty image.

maria: Doing node taint now. Commands I'm running:
```bash
kubectl taint nodes h100-canary-* gpu-driver=broken:NoSchedule
kubectl rollout pause ds/trt-daemonset
```

alex: Long-term: add a driver->PTX compatibility gate in CI. Steps to rebuild safely:
- Recompile flashattn with `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=90`
- Re-run TRT engine build with `--gpu-arch=sm_90`
- Publish new plugin image and run small canary.

jon: Also opening an NVIDIA ticket — new driver behavior seems stricter about PTX versions. Ticket NV-2347 created with stacktraces and build logs.

ops-liz: Heads-up: moving traffic off h100 to A100 will increase utilization on A100 pool and we have limited reserved capacity in eu-west2. If this persists >4h we start burning burst credits and may hit throttles.

maria: Plan for next 6h: 1) keep canary tainted / no new h100 allocations, 2) rebuild plugin images on CI with sm_90, 3) stage deploy rebuilt images to a tiny canary subset (with driver pinned), 4) roll forward once green. Will create a runbook section.

ml-ops: Also add a temporary router rule to prefer dedicated pools for critical inference routes: `policy: prefer_pool: dedicated-A100` (this reduces cold impacts).

alex: If rebuild path blocked, we can set TRT fallback env `TRT_FORCE_FALLBACK=1` to force slower but compatible kernels. Cost & latency tradeoffs apply.

maria: Copy — coordinating CI builds + Nvidia. Posting progress here. :thumbsup:
